remarks: Set just blocks from grocery stores, shops, restaurants, and the train, this 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home offers more than 4,200 sq. ft. across 4 finished levels with an elevator. The build quality shows in every detail: wide-plank hardwood floors, high ceilings, custom millwork, and oversized windows that flood each room with light. The main level centers on a bright kitchen with large island, stainless appliances, and open flow into the family room with fireplace and backyard access. Sliding barn doors open to a flexible living space, while a front office provides privacy for work or study. Upstairs, the primary suite features a walk-in closet with built-in shelving and a bath with soaking tub, along with 2 additional bedrooms, a full bath, and laundry. The 3rd floor adds a vaulted playroom and another bedroom with bath. The lower level includes a 5th bedroom, full bath, and a tiled mudroom with custom built-ins. A fully fenced yard and stone patio complete this in-town property, offering both quality and proximity to everything New Canaan has to offer.
